intro.intro:
Hello, I'm Greg Obis. In 2025 I took over [Chicago Mastering Service](https://chicagomasteringservice.com/), the studio where I started as an intern working for founders Bob Weston & Jason Ward. I’ve mastered hundreds of records over the last 13+ years for artists on labels such as Sub Pop, Matador, ANTI-, Car Park, Captured Tracks, Hardly Art, Sacred Bones, Numero Group, Fire Talk, Winspear, Exploding in Sound and International Anthem to name a few. 

In addition to my studio work, I have traveled the country as a front of house and tour manager for the likes of Jessica Pratt, Protomartyr, Yard Act, La Luz, and more. 

In my free time, I play guitar and sing in the band [Stuck](https://stuckchi.bandcamp.com/). 

This website showcases a limited discography of projects I’ve had the pleasure of working on. I would love to work on yours too!
